## 席位核对 — REWORK · repo:objectstack#3 · head b84c1385 · 2026-11-24T13:29Z

L1 read of #36979 (card #36966, p1) at `b84c1385a2fe0dceda2ea0a1590aee566215d9e3`. Clause-② no and Metadata-protocol none, both true: this is console page state only, with no published surface. NOT governed, 555 changed lines, no contract review owed. `l1-face` is clean.

**What holds.**
- **Codec.** `approvalsInboxUrlState.ts` is strict and quiet. A default writes no param, and an unknown tab, sort or status reads as the default. A status on the pending tab is dropped, because that tab draws no status control. `applyInboxUrlState` keeps params it does not own (`request` and others). The tab rides `scope`, because `tab` is the console's reserved record-page param.
- **Writes.** Every write is `replace: true`. The draft follows the address only on a non-REPLACE navigation (Back, Forward, or a link), never on the page's own writes. The 350 ms debounce now writes `q`, and `serverQuery` reads it, empty on the pending tab, as before. `openRequest` flushes a pending draft into the inbox's own entry, with a replace, before the push. History is written synchronously, so Back lands on the flushed entry. `approvalQueueState` carries the flushed search. Tab change clears the five parts in one write.
- **Reload keeps state.** The dev's open question (1) is answered right: the card asks for survival, and the inbox has no saved-view baseline to reset to.
- **Pins.** They cover the card's scenario end to end, reload, flush-on-open, one history entry, defaults, tab clearing and `?request=`.
- The changeset names `@object-ui/console` and `@objectstack/console` at patch, and its sentences hold, except the one S1 makes untrue.

**S1 (should-fix): the first-load check drops a real filter on the paginated tabs.** On "Submitted by me" and "All", the `process` and `object` filters are client-side over the rows loaded so far: page 1 is `limit: 50, offset: 0`, and `loadMore` appends further pages. `processOptions` and `objectOptions` come from those rows. The new `seedFiltersChecked` effect runs once, at the first load that answers rows, which is page 1 only. It writes `process` / `object` back to `all` when no page-1 row carries the value.

The failure case: the reader on All loads more pages, picks a process (or object) that appears only past the newest 50 (the dropdown offers it, since its rows are loaded), opens a request and presses Back. The remount reloads page 1, the check finds no carrier, and the filter is erased from the address. That is the card's own scenario, losing a filter on Back, in any inbox with more than one page. A reload or a copied link of such an address loses it the same way.

Fix: only judge a seeded value when the loaded rows are the whole answer, that is, on the pending tab (unpaginated) or when `rows.length >= total`. Otherwise keep the value, for example by offering it in the dropdown so the Select can show it. Add a pin for the case: a paginated tab whose page 1 lacks the value, with `total > rows`, keeps it in the address and in the control. Add a control: the full set is loaded and the value is absent, so it is dropped. Then make the changeset sentence ("dropped from the address once the first rows arrive") say when.

**Nits.**
- N1. Draft #36960 edits the same file (option list). The area says it runs overlap-check against this PR, so whichever lands second rebases.

**Mechanical.** All-checks: 32 success · 13 expected skips · 0 failed · 0 pending. Floor checks are green, `mergeable_state` is clean, and `Fixes #36966` delivers the card once S1 is in.

**REWORK** on S1. The delta is an L1 read of the fix and the new pin on a green head.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#3 · head de64b69a · 2026-11-24T14:26Z

Delta L1 read of #36979 (card #36966, p1) on REWORK 7132925317, at `de64b69a594163924428ba5aa3a11323b0bdce78`. Three commits since `b84c1385`: the fix, a test settle, and the changeset sentence.

- **S1: closed.** The seed check still runs once, at the first load that answers rows. It now judges only when those rows are the whole answer: `tab === 'pending' || total === null || rows.length >= total`. On a paginated tab with more pages it keeps the value and stops checking. The dropdowns are built from the rows' values plus the filter in force (`processOptions` / `objectOptions` over `rowProcesses` / `rowObjects`), so a kept value shows in its Select and can be cleared. An object with no loaded label shows by its machine name. The drop path compares against the rows' own values, not the widened options, so it is not short-circuited. `setRows` and `setTotal` land in the same async turn, so the check never reads a page-1 `rows` against a stale `total`.
- **Pins.** New case 9: on a paginated All tab whose page 1 lacks both values, the address keeps both params and the triggers show them. Case 6 is now the full-set control, where the value is absent and dropped. All three ablations go red: guard removed reds case 9, `wholeAnswer=false` reds case 6, and dropping the kept dropdown value reds case 9. The dev disclosed that the guard ablation's first run stayed green because the pin read the address before the router's transition committed. The fix, a settle plus a trigger assertion, makes that pin actually test the guard, and its re-run went red as it should.
- **Changeset.** The sentence now says when a value is dropped (pending, or the first page holds every request) and that a value past page 1 is kept and shown. That matches the code. The PR body's "Invalid values" bullet and cases 6 and 9 match too.
- N1 (#36960 overlap) is unchanged.

Every open finding is a nit. **ACCEPT**, ordinary queue landing.
